summary: Two manifests were found, package.json and requirements.txt, and neither has a lockfile. Two runtime dependencies are unpinned: express with `*` and gunicorn with no version. Pinned versions were not checked for vulnerabilities, because that belongs to a different step.

findings.title: express uses wildcard version with no lockfile
findings.evidence: "express": "*" — any version is accepted and no lockfile exists beside package.json to pin it
findings.recommendation: Pin express to a specific version or a bounded range, and commit a lockfile (package-lock.json).

findings.title: gunicorn has no version constraint and no lockfile
findings.evidence: gunicorn — no version specified, and no lockfile or constraints file pins it
findings.recommendation: Pin gunicorn with an exact version (gunicorn==X.Y.Z) and consider a hash-locked requirements file.

limitations: Known vulnerabilities were not examined, because this step covers hygiene only.
No lockfile exists for npm or PyPI, so transitive dependencies are unpinned and were not reviewed.
